entry.name: jit.anim.node
entry.description: The jit.anim.node object represents a transformation (position, orientation and scale) in 3D space. OpenGL objects bind to a jit.anim.node and receive position, rotate, and scale attributes. In addition, parent-child relationships can be established in a hierarchical transformation structure, where child jit.anim.node objects are transformed relative to their parents.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.digest: Adjust the node anchor (pivot) position
attributes.description: Adjust the node anchor (pivot) position (default = 0 0 0). This is the position around which the node will rotate.

attributes.description: Enable automatic updates from draw context (default = 1).

attributes.description: Determines which space themessage will affect the position of this node (default = parent).

attributes.description: The instance name. Ob3ds can set theirattribute to this value to bind to this node.

attributes.digest: Set by the node named by the anim attribute.
attributes.description: Set by the node named by the anim attribute. Specifies a position in 3D space that will be concatenated with the local position to derive the world position. (default = 0 0 0)

attributes.digest: Set by the node named by the anim attribute.
attributes.description: Set by the node named by the anim attribute. Specifies a quaternion orientation that will be concatenated with the local orientation to derive the world orientation. (default = 0 0 0 1)

attributes.description: Set by the node named by the anim attribute. Specifies an angle-axis orientation that will be concatenated with the local orientation to derive the world orientation. (default = 0 0 0 1)

attributes.name: parentscale
attributes.digest: Set by the node named by the anim attribute.
attributes.description: Set by the node named by the anim attribute. Specifies a scale value that will be concatenated with the local scale to derive the world scale. (default = 1 1 1)

messages.name: anim_grow
messages.description: Scale the node along each axis by the amount provided.

messages.name: anim_move
messages.description: Move the node along the axis provided, relative to the space indicated by.

messages.name: anim_reset
messages.description: Reset the local transformation attributes to their default values (position = 0 0 0, rotatexyz = 0 0 0, and scale = 1 1 1)

messages.name: anim_turn
messages.description: Rotate the node along each axis by the amount provided, relative to the space indicated by.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Output the current world transform coordinates, which is a concatenation of the local transform with the parent transform.

messages.name: concat
messages.digest: Concatenate (multiply) the current transform with the passed in 4x4 matrix
messages.description: Concatenate (multiply) the current transform with the passed in 4x4 matrix. Local transform attributes are updated after the operation.

messages.name: localtoworld
messages.digest: Retrieve the world-space position from passed in local coordinates
messages.description: Retrieve the world-space position from passed in local coordinates. The local coordinates are relative to the current world-space transform.

messages.name: localtoworld_quat
messages.digest: Retrieve the world-space quaternion from passed in local quaternion
messages.description: Retrieve the world-space quaternion from passed in local quaternion. The returned quaternion is the product of to the current world-space quaternion and the local quaternion.

messages.name: worldtolocal
messages.digest: Retrieve the local-space position from passed in world coordinates
messages.description: Retrieve the local-space position from passed in world coordinates. The local coordinates are relative to the current world-space transform.

messages.name: worldtolocal_quat
messages.digest: Retrieve the local quaternion from passed in world-space quaternion
messages.description: Retrieve the local quaternion from passed in world quaternion. The returned quaternion is the product of to the current inverse world-space quaternion and the world quaternion.
